summary: INTERIM results for investigation OT-26-S0177, the BP16 protease inhibitor genotoxicity battery for Belquorin Pharma. The bacterial mutation assay with and without S9 is complete. HepG2 viability exclusions are recorded. Mammalian-cell micronucleus repeat scoring is still open, and several cells are marked [TBC] until the repeat plates are read.
